face.name: 淤泥喷射者
face.text: 嘲讽，亡语：召唤一个1/2并具有嘲讽的泥浆怪。
face.flavorText: 千万别让他喝碳酸饮料！

face.name: Sludge Belcher
face.text: Taunt Deathrattle: Summon a 1/2 Slime with Taunt.
face.flavorText: DO NOT GIVE HIM A ROOT BEER.

face.name: 白眼大侠
face.text: 嘲讽，亡语： 将风暴守护者洗入你的牌库。
face.flavorText: 他的独门绝技就是朝你翻白眼。

face.name: White Eyes
face.text: Taunt Deathrattle: Shuffle 'The Storm Guardian' into your deck.
face.flavorText: My life for Aya!

face.name: 恐角龙宝宝
face.text: 嘲讽。亡语： 将一张8/12并具有嘲讽的“恐角龙头领”洗入你的牌库。
face.flavorText: 打恐龙也要看妈妈。

face.name: Direhorn Hatchling
face.text: Taunt Deathrattle: Shuffle an 8/12 Direhorn with Taunt into your deck.
face.flavorText: His mom could beat up your mom.

face.name: 索莉多米
face.text: 休眠2回合。唤醒时，使你手牌中所有龙牌的法力值消耗减少（4）点。
face.flavorText: 啊？我刚才睡着了。

face.name: Soridormi
face.text: Dormant for 2 turns. When this awakens, reduce the Cost of all Dragons in your hand by (4).
face.flavorText: Perdón! I slept.

face.name: 筑巢双头鹏
face.text: 战吼：如果你控制至少两个其他随从，便获得嘲讽。
face.flavorText: 双头鹏会用蛋来诱捕那些偷蛋贼。正所谓螳螂捕蝉，大鹏在后。

face.name: Nesting Roc
face.text: Battlecry: If you control at least 2 other minions, gain Taunt.
face.flavorText: Roc eggs are great in omelettes, sandwiches, and as bait to turn poachers into bird food.

face.name: 黑翼腐蚀者
face.text: 战吼：如果你的手牌中有龙牌，则造成5点伤害。
face.flavorText: 当他把几本漫画书和几张摇滚碟片带回黑石山的时候，他就获得了“腐蚀者”的称号。

face.name: Blackwing Corruptor
face.text: Battlecry: If you're holding a Dragon, deal 5 damage.
face.flavorText: He got his name when he gave Blackwing some comic books and rock & roll records.

face.name: 欧米茄探员
face.text: 战吼：如果你有十个法力水晶，召唤本随从的两个复制。
face.flavorText: 不只是寻找真相，她们还会给对手十秒钟的时间，再进行抓捕。

face.name: Omega Agent
face.text: Battlecry: If you have 10 Mana Crystals, summon 2 copies of this minion.
face.flavorText: They don't just find the truth. They give it a ten second head start, then hunt it down.

face.name: 莫尔杉精锐
face.text: 嘲讽。战吼：在本回合中，如果你的英雄进行过攻击，则召唤一个本随从的复制。
face.flavorText: “不管刷过多少木桩，兽人都算不上可怕；蹲尸体的兽人才是真的可怕！”

face.name: Mor'shan Elite
face.text: Taunt. Battlecry: If your hero attacked this turn, summon a copy of this.
face.flavorText: "Fear not the orc who has slain a million training dummies, but the orc who keeps CAMPING MY CORPSE!"

MorShan uses public hero_attack_count with completed voluntary original hero attack in current owner_turn; bare damage, minion attacks and earlier intervals do not qualify. Both require original live source; requests capture original BoardPresenceReference and native SummonCause, then each existing CopyMinion accepts full current material and actual capacity at its own window. Accepted awakening invokes fresh current own hand references, MinionScope HAND current Dragon query incl ALL/exclusions, then ordinary ModifyStoredCost delta-4 with floor0. No later cards, foreign hand or printed-only filter; unknown current tribes fail. Native countdown/owner/controller/lifecycle/reentry and copying remain public; accepted external reward survives later source death.

At least2 grants Taunt to original live MinionReference through existing GrantCapturedKeyword. No permanent aura or repeated conditional reevaluation.
